mapper.sql: id, task_id, organization_id, change_type, target_parent_id, expected_version, organization_code_snapshot, organization_name_snapshot, from_parent_id_snapshot, reason, execution_status, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_organization_change ( id, task_id, organization_id, change_type, target_parent_id, expected_version, organization_code_snapshot, organization_name_snapshot, from_parent_id_snapshot, reason, execution_status, failure_reason ) VALUES ( #{change.id}, #{change.taskId}, #{change.organizationId}, #{change.changeType}, #{change.targetParentId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{change.expectedVersion}, #{change.organizationCodeSnapshot}, #{change.organizationNameSnapshot}, #{change.fromParentIdSnapshot, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{change.reason}, #{change.executionStatus}, #{change.failureReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_organization_change ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization_change change_record JOIN sys_system_task task ON task.id = change_record.task_id WHERE change_record.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND change_record.execution_status = 'PENDING' AND task.status IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'APPROVED') )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_organization_change SET execution_status = 'APPLIED', failure_reason = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE sys_organization_change SET execution_status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND execution_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT before_status FROM sys_organization_change_audit WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND event_type = 'REQUEST' ORDER BY occurred_at, id LIMIT 1
